status: SIMULATED: not the expert set and not an evaluation result (B-D22). Written by Claude on 4 November 2026 at Tri's request, to test an event graph on totals over time. No drilling expert has reviewed it. Frozen before the event graph was built: do not change a question or gold value because of a result; add a new version instead.
gold_source: Computed by code from the PDF text layer of attachments 30 and 28, and of the non-productive-time report, appx-23 (sums to its printed Well Total of 115.00). Independent of the parsed chunks. Every day sums to 24 hours except 26 August (23.5), where the report itself has no row for 18:15 to 18:45.
known_limits: Chosen to suit a graph of events: it shows whether a graph can help on totals over time, not whether users ask such questions.
The author wrote the questions knowing what the graph would do.
